# Copilot code-review instructions

This repo is a BepInEx 6 (IL2CPP) Harmony mod for *Survival Log*. Plugins derive from `BasePlugin` and call the game through Il2CppInterop proxy assemblies. Review with these traps in mind; a general C# review misses most of them.

## IL2CPP Harmony traps

- **Getter/setter patches often never fire.** il2cpp inlines trivial accessors, so a `MethodType.Getter`/`.Setter` patch silently does nothing. Flag a new getter patch used as the only mechanism. The reliable change is mutating the backing field at a load hook.
- **Inlined methods.** il2cpp also inlines some private methods into their only caller, and a patch of such a method attaches with no error but never runs. A method with no caller in the native code of the game is inlined or called virtually (`ItemManager.SetItemCount`, `WebUILayer.ShowPage`). Flag a new patch target that is not shown to run in the game.
- **No `is`/`as` across the interop boundary.** Flag `is`, `as`, or a direct cast on a game type. The correct form is `x.TryCast<T>()` then a null check.
- **No `foreach` over game collections.** The interop enumerator lacks the pattern. Expect `GetEnumerator()` / `MoveNext()` / `Current`, or a count plus an indexer.
- **Never read an `Il2CppSystem.ValueTuple<...>` result of a game method,** direct or as a list element. The interop layer reads the fields wrongly and gives garbage with no error. Expect a method that returns a class, a dictionary, or an `Il2CppStructArray`, or the value calculated in the mod.
- **A patch of a method that gives a value declares `__result`.** A Prefix that returns false and leaves `__result` unset gives the default value to the caller. The one Prefix of this mod (`PageMessages`) returns false only for a message with the prefix of this mod (`slmod|itemtotals|`) and lets each other message through. Flag a Prefix that skips the game's method for any other input.
- **Guard game lookups.** Singletons, config lookups, and the web view return null often. Flag an unchecked dereference inside a patch.
- **A patch must not break the game.** A patch that does more than set the dirty bit sits in a try/catch that logs each distinct error once and leaves the game's result unchanged, so the window shows as without the mod.
- **Data states come from `GetData`.** `ReduxUISystem.GetState<T>` reads only the window states (`State_Web_*`) and gives null for a data state. Read a `State_Data_*` state (for example `State_Data_Item`) with `ReduxUISystem.GetData<T>`. Flag `GetState` of a data state.

## Web UI

- The game UI is web pages in one web view: a root page hosts each window as an iframe. New DOM comes from a script run in the root page through `ExecuteJavaScript`, which reaches a window through `iframe.contentWindow`.
- A reopened window is a new iframe. Flag a page hook that installs once and assumes it stays.
- A page hook wraps the game's function and calls the original first. Flag a hook that replaces the original, or page code with no try/catch around the added DOM work.
- Text that goes into a script string must have no quote or backslash, or must be escaped (`JsonText.Str` or `AppendStr` of the JSON library in `src/Shared/json/`).
- **Send once.** The page script (`src/Web/page/*.ts`, TypeScript built by Vite into one file that the plugin embeds) goes to the root page only when the root page answers that it has no script. `setData(data)` goes only when the data version differs from the version that the page confirmed. A window refresh with the data already there sends only the apply of the line. The game-free `src/Web/PushSchedule.cs` decides each send, sends at most one call for each frame, and is the only retry. Flag a send of the script or the data on each refresh or on a hover, and a retry loop (`setTimeout`) in the page script.
- **The tooltip block goes through the tooltip lines library.** `install.ts` registers one block with `addTipLines` (`src/Shared/tooltip-lines/`) at rank 40. The library owns the wrap of the tooltip part of each web page, the place and the order of the blocks of every mod, and the correction for a tooltip that grew past the window. The layout of the block and the rule above it come from `tooltipLinesCss('it')` and the `--it-tip-*` variables of `tokens.css`. Flag a wrap of a tooltip function of the game in the mod, a hand-written rule or layout for the block, and a line that is appended straight to a tooltip node.
- **Two windows build their text in C#.** The workbench window: a Postfix of `Reducer_Web_ToolTable.RA_ItemHover` appends the line to the tooltip text, and `toolTable.ts` moves it out of the text into a block of the same shape. The item detail popup: Postfixes of `Reducer_Web_ItemDetailPopup.RA_OpenUI` and `RA_RefreshUI` send the number, and `popup.ts` writes it into the head line after the weight and the size. Flag a second line in either window.
- **Styles live in CSS files.** `src/Web/tokens.css` holds the `--it-` tokens and `src/Web/page.css` the rules; stylelint checks that a rule uses a token, not a raw color. The script sets classes (`it-*`). Flag a raw color or an inline style in the page script.

## Structure and tests

- **Feature folders.** `src/Plugin.cs` holds only the plugin: the config, the patch list, and `Load`. `src/Totals/` reads the item pool, calculates the item totals, and holds the patches that mark them dirty. `src/Text/` holds the two windows whose text C# builds. `src/Web/` holds the page script, its CSS, and the C# that sends it. Each patch class is attached on its own in the patch list of `Load`, so a target missing after a game update turns off only its own part.
- **Pure logic is separated and tested.** Logic that does not need the running game (the totals of a pool, the dirty bit and the data version, the line text, the hover JSON, the popup sends, the send schedule, the page JSON) lives in its own file with no BepInEx or Il2Cpp reference, unit-tested under `tests/ItemTotals.Tests`. Flag new pure logic in a patch class, and new pure logic with no test. The page script has Vitest tests against the game's own web pages under `tests/page/`.
- **The per-frame tick is guarded.** `PageTick` (a Postfix of `WebUILayer.OnUpdate`) runs inside one try/catch, and each distinct warning logs once. Flag work in it that runs on each frame while no item changed and no send is pending.
- `netstandard2.1` has no JSON library and the game's Newtonsoft stub cannot be used, so the JSON library in `src/Shared/json/` (`JsonText`, `FlatJson`) is on purpose. Do not suggest `System.Text.Json`.
- **`src/Shared/` is a library copy.** Each folder `src/Shared/<lib>/` is a copy of a shared library of the modding workspace, at the version that its `VERSION` file names, with a hash of each file and a header line in each `.cs`, `.ts`, and `.css` file (the JSON library, the i18n library of the mod texts, and the tooltip lines library). It is never edited in this repo: a fix goes into the shared library and comes back with a sync, which also writes `VERSION`. Flag a change of a file under `src/Shared/` with no change of its `VERSION` file.
- **Mod texts come from the i18n files.** Each text that the mod shows is in `src/i18n/en.json` (each text, the last fallback) and `zh.json`, and the code asks for it by name through the i18n library (`src/Shared/i18n/`). Only `src/ModTexts.cs` reads `LanguageType`. Flag a check of the display language anywhere else, an English or Chinese text in C# or page code, and a page fallback text.
- **Patches** prefer a postfix, and tie the `Harmony` instance to the plugin GUID.

## Game rules the mod keeps

- **The item pool comes from the bag mirror.** `src/Totals/Pool.cs` reads `State_Data_Item.OwnerCache` for the backpack of the leading character, each furniture that passes the game's `ItemManager.IsInHomeScope`, and the workbench drawer. It never calls `ItemManager.GetAllAvailableItems`: that call walks the home scope and makes each later item move reach about fifty item managers, which the player sees as a delay of seconds on a drag. Flag that call, and any other walk of the home scope through `ItemManager`.
- **Only the home.** A box on the floor and the box of a vehicle (the extra tabs of the backpack window) are not home storage and are not counted, as the crafting count of the game does not count them. Flag a source that widens the pool past the home scope.
- **The cost sits on an item change, never on a hover.** The four invalidate patches of `ItemManager` (`AddItemToOwnerCache`, `IncreaseItemCount`, `DetachItemFromOwnerCaches`, `CostItem`) only set the dirty bit. The tick calculates at most once for a frame, and the two windows whose text C# builds read through `Store.Read`, which calculates first when the bit is set. A hover asks the game for nothing. Flag a calculation or a game call on a hover, and work in an invalidate patch beyond the dirty bit and its debug line.
- **`Total: 0` shows.** An item that the character does not hold shows the line with 0. The line shows nothing only when the item pool could not be read. Flag a change that hides the line for 0.
- **The battle world only after the game created it.** `BaseSingleton<T>.Instance` creates the instance when none exists, so a read from the tick at the title screen builds a `BattleLogicWorld` outside the game's flow. Read the world only through `GameWorld.Current` (`src/GameWorld.cs`), which checks `IsInstanceCreated` first. Flag a direct read of `BaseSingleton<BattleLogicWorld>.Instance`.
- **Display only.** The mod must not change what the game counts, moves, crafts, or sells, change an owner list of the game, write to the save, or change a game file. The lines of the game in each tooltip stay unchanged and in their order. Flag any write of game state.

## Release and config hygiene

- **One config entry.** `General` / `Verbose` (default `false`) is the only entry. Diagnostic tracing goes on `LogDebug` behind it; `LogInfo` stays quiet apart from the load line. Flag a new entry with no `CONFIG.md` row.
- **The plugin GUID never changes.** It is `com.ivmakk.survivallog.itemtotals`, the BepInEx identity and the config file name. Flag any edit to it.
- **The version is in two places that must agree:** `<Version>` in the csproj and the `BepInPlugin` attribute.
- **No committed build output.** Flag `bin/`, `obj/`, `dist/`, `node_modules/`, or a game DLL in the diff. The build runs Vite, so it needs `npm ci` at the mod root; a change of the npm packages commits `package-lock.json`. Game `<Reference>` entries keep `<Private>false</Private>`.
- **Changelog matches the change.** A player-visible change adds an `[Unreleased]` entry to `CHANGELOG.md` in player-facing wording. An internal-only refactor gets none.
